verdict.rationale: Unity's docs say one project builds for 25+ platforms ('any platform'), using per-platform build profiles in the Editor. Build Automation runs multiplatform builds simultaneously, including iOS, and a community comment confirms Unity is a solid way to build cross-platform and target iOS. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of console export (direct or via partner programs), explicit naming of desktop targets, and hands-on corroboration of shipping one project across desktop, mobile, and console.
